providers.name: Galaxy, procedurally generated by scripts/generate-procedural-textures.mjs (no third-party material)

review.note: No spacecraft has ever visited Orcus and it is not part of Solar System Scope's illustrative dwarf-planet set (checked live 2026-08-27), so no external image of any kind exists to source. Procedurally generated surface (no external asset, no third-party licence) parameterized from the actual literature: Barucci et al. 2008 detected crystalline water ice + a possible ammonia-hydrate band, evidence of a cryovolcanic resurfacing event — rendered as light cratering (old craters erased by resurfacing) plus brighter irregular ice-patch regions, not just a generic bump map.
